Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.

The petitioner has challenged the recovery certificate dated 15.10.2022 issued by respondent no.4 for recovery of the penalty imposed on the petitioner under the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The amount is Rs.1 lakh plus recovery charges.
Counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner is ready to pay the amount in installments.
Learned standing counsel has no objection to the same.
Accordingly, the petition is disposed of by providing that the petitioner shall deposit the entire amount in three equal monthly installments.

The first installment will become due and payable on Manoj Kumar Agrawal vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168046907/
1 31.04.2023 and next installments on the last day of each successive months.
